findings.text: The company was incorporated on 4 October 1971 and has been active for 55.1 years.
There are 10 current officers, comprising 9 directors and 1 other officer, though some records may be missing due to data caps.
CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1815 is the sole person with significant control, holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
Accounts are not overdue, with the last made up to 31 December 2025 and the next due on 30 June 2027.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the last made up to 1 November 2025 and the next due on 15 November 2026.
There are 92 outstanding charges registered against the company, out of a total of 308 charges.
No insolvency record is held for the company by Companies House.
One director, PERSON 421, resigned on 6 May 2026, and there have been no registered office address changes since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 475 is an active company with no insolvency records, up-to-date filings, and 92 outstanding charges.
